summary: A change in sorting rules can remove hundreds of distinctions from a return worker's shift.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909 and LD 1910, DEP staff estimated that grouping containers by material and size could reduce the number of sorts from more than seven hundred to about thirty.
gates: A center has a current sort list and a proposed material-based list.
